name: iNature Australia
summary: Perth-area online commerce/web firm (c.1997); wound down by 2005 (INATURE AUSTRALIA PTY LTD, ACN 079 812 883).

events.details: Site redirected to shoponline.com.au; wound down. With iNature-branded content last archived May 2001 and ShopOnline occupying the domain by Dec 2004, the 'by 2004' proposal is promoted over the current c. 2005. domain folded into ShopOnline Australia.

refs.label: May 2001: last iNature-branded capture (an e-commerce/web-solutions company, not visibly selling internet access as early as 1998-2000).
By 13 Dec 2004 the domain serves/forwards the ShopOnline Australia directory (later Crazy Domains parked) - iNature identity gone.
ABR: INATURE AUSTRALIA PTY LTD ACN 079 812 883
